summary: Tested all new features: communities, follow system, image upload, sidebar layout, mobile bottom nav. All 15 backend tests passed. All frontend flows verified via Playwright.

issues: Join button stays as icon (UserPlus) after clicking, does not change to text 'Leave'. Member count in sidebar updates correctly. Minor UX issue - user might not know they joined.

Communities list page join button icon doesn't visually change to 'Leave' - only member count in sidebar updates. Consider changing button label/icon to indicate joined state.
